title: The Story of Nian
summary: A mountain village mistakes its ancient guardian for a monster after a missing scale brings drought and fear.
author: Uncredited

vote_config.title: Choose the village's final answer
vote_config.instruction: Choose the response that best protects the village and answers the messenger's demand. Each player may vote once.

options.name: Return the scale and reveal the truth
options.description: Return the scale and publicly acknowledge Nian as the guardian.

options.name: Return the scale but hide the old secret
options.description: Restore the scale while keeping the village's past concealed.

options.name: Let the merchant keep the scale
options.description: Protect the merchant's claim and refuse to return it.

options.name: Drive the messenger away
options.description: Reject dialogue and treat Nian as a monster.
